notes:
v4.6.0 — broker-scoped bots, API key fix, automation restored

✨ NEW
• Broker-scoped bot registry: Alpaca and IBKR now have completely independent bot lists. Switching to IBKR shows no active bot tabs; LONG/SHORT/DAY appear in the Silenced section since they're Alpaca-only.
• Auto-start at market open section restored to its own prominent block in Tools — always visible regardless of broker mode.

🐛 FIXED
• API key slot assignment: keys saved via Tools → ALPACA API KEYS now reliably reach the bot processes. Added explicit APEX_DATA_DIR propagation to all bot subprocesses and direct .env path loading in longbot, shortbot, and daybot.
• Slot save now verifies the write succeeded and shows exactly which bots got keys, or a clear error if something went wrong.
• Bot registry is now per-user AND per-broker — switching accounts or brokers no longer bleeds one user's bots into another's view.
